description: The llama-swap operations console — durable history, drain-aware control, and measurement commands that structurally cannot produce the errors operators actually make.

tools.name: activity_log
tools.description: Per-request activity log: id, timestamp, model, HTTP status, cached/prompt/generated token counts, prompt speed, generation speed, duration. Model-scoped, paginated and sortable via query params (verified live against the v249 UI). This history is IN-MEMORY — a proxy restart zeroes it, which is exactly why the CLI mirrors it into SQLite. Optional: model, page, limit (plus 2 more).

tools.name: activity_performance
tools.description: Performance metrics feed backing the UI's Performance page (per-model speed distributions).

tools.name: activity_prometheus
tools.description: Prometheus exposition of proxy metrics. Returns 503 when monitoring is disabled in config — treat 503 as 'feature off', not proxy-down.

tools.name: activity_stats
tools.description: Aggregated activity stats (request counts, token totals) since proxy start.

tools.name: captures_get
tools.description: Full request/response capture for one activity entry — the body-level diagnostic for 'what did the client actually send and what came back'. 404 when capture wasn't enabled or the buffer rotated past this id. Required: id.

tools.name: inflight_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one in-flight request by its id (ids visible in the activity feed / UI in-flight table). The polite alternative to unloading a model out from under a stuck request. Required: id.

tools.name: logs_get
tools.description: Buffered recent logs as plain text (proxy + upstream stdout/stderr interleaved). For live following the server also exposes SSE at /logs/stream and per-source /logs/stream/{proxy|upstream|model_id} — the CLI's follow mode consumes those.

tools.name: models_list
tools.description: Every CONFIGURED model (from config YAML), not just loaded ones. Extended fields per entry: name, description, architecture, capabilities, supported_parameters, context_length, status.value, and meta.llamaswap.aliases. CRITICAL: data[].id is the canonical id; harness-bound aliases hide in meta.llamaswap.aliases — matching id alone reports a correctly-served alias as missing (the exact bug in 2 of 3 clients in the offload-harness today). This roster is CONFIG-derived: a model whose GGUF file was never downloaded still appears here and fails only when called.

tools.name: models_running
tools.description: Only the models currently holding VRAM: {running:[{model, state, cmd, proxy, ttl, name, description}]}. state is 'ready' once health-checked. ttl==0 means deliberately resident (keep-set); any other ttl means the model self-unloads after idle. This is the ground truth for 'what is actually loaded' — /v1/models is config, /running is VRAM.

tools.name: models_unload
tools.description: Unload ONE model by id. WARNING (measured on this deployment): an unload issued during an in-flight generation returns in ~1.3s WITHOUT draining and the in-flight request dies with 502. Check /upstream/{model}/slots is_processing (or /running + activity) before unloading anything that might be serving. Route exists on v24x+. Required: model.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id (canonical id from /v1/models, not an alias).

tools.name: models_unload_all
tools.description: Unload EVERY model, including ttl:0 keep-set residents. On this deployment that kills the mem0 memory stack (embeddinggemma + bge-reranker-v2-m3) until their next request re-warms them. Prefer per-model unload with a keep-set exclusion.

tools.name: profiles_activate
tools.description: Switch the active profile. Body is the profile selection object.

tools.name: profiles_list
tools.description: List configured profiles and which one is active. 404 on pre-v241 servers.

tools.name: server_hardware
tools.description: Hardware detection as llama-swap sees it (GPUs, VRAM). Added in v247 — returns 404 on older servers; treat 404 as 'feature absent', not an error.

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Liveness of the llama-swap proxy itself (plain 'OK'). This says NOTHING about any model being loaded or ready — a green /health with an empty /running is the normal idle state. For per-model readiness use upstream health.

tools.name: server_version
tools.description: Returns {version, commit, build_date}. The capability gate for everything else: per-model unload routes need v24x+, /api/hardware needs v247+, profiles/selectors need v241+. Cache this and gate optional commands on it instead of guessing from 404s.

tools.name: upstream_apply_template
tools.description: Render OpenAI-style messages through the model's chat template WITHOUT generating — returns the exact prompt string. Pair with tokenize for precise budget math. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_detokenize
tools.description: Convert token ids back to text. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_embeddings
tools.description: Embeddings from an embedding-capable model (on this deployment embeddinggemma, 768-dim, resident). Also dispatchable proxy-wide at /v1/embeddings; the upstream form pins the exact model. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_health
tools.description: Per-model readiness ({'status':'ok'} once loaded; 503 while loading). Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_lora_adapters
tools.description: List LoRA adapters loaded on this model and their scales. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_lora_set
tools.description: Set LoRA adapter scales on this model. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_metrics
tools.description: Per-model llama-server Prometheus metrics (needs --metrics on the seat; 404 otherwise). Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_props
tools.description: llama-server properties for one model: build_info, model_path, chat_template, modalities, total_slots, default_generation_settings (incl. the REAL loaded n_ctx — the authority for context-window sizing; assuming ctx from config has killed real runs with exceed_context_size 400s). Required: model.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id (auto-starts the model if idle).

tools.name: upstream_rerank
tools.description: Rerank documents against a query with a reranker model (on this deployment bge-reranker-v2-m3, resident, CPU-bound). Note the harness config declares rerank as a first-class roster member but today only a bench script can reach it — this command closes that gap. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_slots
tools.description: Per-slot state incl. is_processing — the drain signal before unload. CAVEATS: needs llama-server started with --slots (404/501 otherwise — on this deployment most seats do not pass it); on non-llama.cpp upstreams (whisper-server) 404 is ambiguous with 'not loaded' and must be cross-checked against /running; slot state exposes prompt content, so treat output as sensitive. Required: model.

tools.name: upstream_tokenize
tools.description: Tokenize text with the model's own tokenizer. The honest answer to 'does this fit the context window' — chars/4 estimates are ~2x off on Gemma-family tokenizers (measured). Required: model.
